repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate uses a 1000 ms wrapper period with a threshold of 30, causing the action to fire after 30 seconds (29 ticks * 1000ms + 1 tick). The IR requires the condition to hold for exactly 30 seconds (300 ticks of 100ms). With a 1000 ms wrapper, the system cannot detect a condition drop and recovery between iterations, making the 1000 ms period invalid for this sustain duration. The fix requires switching to a 100 ms wrapper period and adjusting the threshold to 301 (300 ticks + 1) to ensure the action fires exactly at the 30-second mark.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the wrapper period from 1000 to 100 ms to allow the sustain window to be measured on a fine enough grid to detect condition changes. Updated the hold threshold from 30 to 301 to account for the initial tick at t=0, ensuring the action triggers precisely after 30 seconds of sustained false motion.
